answer: Rewards go only to agents that pass a random audit: each epoch, three peers from unrelated funding sources re-run a sample of an agent's past answers, and a stake of 300 tokens is burned if the work proves copied. Faking 200 identities means locking 60,000 tokens and passing every spot check, which arrives unannounced like a comet, and splitting money across fresh wallets fails because the audit compares outputs, not just funding. An honest agent stakes once, explains a coral reef or a remote island when asked, and reclaims the stake after twenty clean epochs.
